Flooded Car? Here's what to do:

1. Immediately disconnect the negative cable of your car battery to avoid any possible short circuit. This is also to protect the ECU or computer box from damage.

2. Do not start the engine. Try to push the car out to higher ground or try jacking it with the car jack.

3. Disengage and release the parking brake. Keep the transmission in 1st gear (for manual transmission) or "P" (for automatic transmission) to prevent the brake canvas from sticking. This is even more important for cars that use drum brakes.

4. Take plenty of photos both inside and outside the car to document any damage or how deep the car was underwater. This will be useful for both the Insurance and/or Professional Mechanic to determine the extent of the damage.

5. Wait at least 24 hours before you do anything to the vehicle, giving it time to drain, if not completely dry out.

6. If the water got so deep that the dashboard was covered, do not try to start it at all. If any liquid is in the cylinders it will cause damage to the engine. Most of the electronics in the car would have been submerged at this depth, as well.

7. If you don’t think the water got that high, it’s still best to take a look at the oil dipstick to see if there are any traces of water in the lubrication system. If so, assume the engine is flooded and don’t try to start it.

8. You’re in better shape if the water stayed below the center line of your wheels. Nevertheless, let the interior air out as much as possible before trying to start it, taking out the floor mats, trunk mat and even the seats. Much of the wiring and some of the computers in today’s cars are located under the carpet and console box, so even if the engine compartment was not inundated, you could still experience faults to secondary systems.

9. When in doubt, either have your vehicle towed to your trusted service center, JAKKA SERVICE CENTER or call US for a more thorough inspection and assessment.

To prevent the spread of diseases, Tzu Chi Foundation launched a work-for-relief cleanup drive on November 4. The program accommodated 540 villagers on the first day and 520 on the second day. Each day that they helped clean up their homes and their neighborhood under the program, each resident received Php1, 000 as cash aid. Tzu Chi volunteers also joined in the work, along with the volunteer firefighters of Binondo-Paco Volunteer Fire Search and Rescue Brigade. 

Everyone's concerted effort made it possible to bring the life back to Tierra Verde within only two days.

Recommended post exposure prophylaxis against Leptospirosis:

a. Low Risk (wading in flood waters, without cuts or open wounds)
- Doxycycline 100 mg/cap, 2 capsules, single dose within 24 to 72 hours from exposure
b. Moderate Risk (wading in flood waters with cuts or open wounds or accidental ingestion of flood waters)
- Doxycycline 100 mg/cap, 2 capsules daily for 3 to 5 days within 24 to 72 hours
c. High Risk (with continuous exposure)
- Doxycycline 100 mg/cap, 2 capsules per week until end of exposure

TIPs para sa panahon ng Tag ulan at di maiwasang pag BAHA.

1. Flood preparation na maaring makatulong kung di maiwasan O di na makaiwas sa baha.
            - disconnect the battery- iwas short circuit(park in the safest place)
            - hwg i PARK Mode (kung nasa garage or bahay lang)- try niyo i NUETRAL lang,then secured ang makabilang gulong.(para madaling maitulak O mahila kung kinakailangan).
            - tarpaulin can help (kung nasa garage or bahay lang)- bili ng tamang sukat na tarpualin para ibalot ang boung sasakyan-(applicable sa sedan,hatchback at even SUV/XUV) as in boung sasakyan(iwasan lang na masira ang tarpulin pag apak ng gulong ng sasakyan para di mapasukan ng tubig.(cartoon underneath the tarpulin can help)
            -  balutan ng plastic ang exhaust pipe(tambutso)-para di makapasok ang tubig.
            - tanggalin ang air filter or balutan ng plastic ang air intake manifold- para di makapasok ang tubig.

2. Tips kung ang sasakyan niyo ay inabot ang air filter/air cleaner.(all cars)
            - caution: Hwg niyong subukang i-restart or i crank- delikado sa makina na mag bend ang crankshaft,connecting rod at piston ring damage. lalo lang mapalaki ang gastos niyo sa pag pa-repair.
            - pang madaliang remedy: tanggalin ang spark plug at air cleaner, saka i crank para maitulak ang tubig sa palabas ng cylinder.
            - Final Action: dalhin agad sa qualified techinician para ma check ng maigi para sigurado.

3. Tips kung ang sasakyan niyo ay inabot ang electronic parts.dash board,fuseboard,etc.

           - if flood preparation TIPs was done, then proceed with caution to restore.
            - beware of electronic parts, if necessary,inside compartment should be preheated before restarting. if Moisture content cannot be removed,electronic components will be in danger.(burn,short cktd,etc.)
             - Final Action: dalhin agad sa qualified techinician para ma check ng maigi para sigurado.
